message.content: **Summary:** I read Boeing's (BA) latest 10-K (fiscal year ended 2023-12-31) and checked the live quote ($155.70 last, bid $155.68 / ask $155.72 as of 2024-11-06 15:05 UTC) against your mandate. The filing shows clear improvement on the top line and in cash generation — fiscal 2023 net sales of $77,794M vs. $66,608M in 2022, operating loss narrowing to –$773M from –$3,519M, net loss narrowing to –$2,222M from –$4,935M, and positive operating cash flow of $5,960M — which is why I was willing to buy, but the company is still loss-making with diluted EPS of –$18.36, so I sized the position conservatively rather than fully using the $25,000 per-order allowance. I placed a single buy limit order for 100 shares at $155.75, just a few cents above the current ask so it would execute promptly while staying "close to market"; it filled at $155.75 for roughly $15,575, well under both the $25,000 per-order and $50,000 daily caps. No funds were moved out of the account, and the order was a buy in BA only — both consistent with your standing mandate. Cash remaining is about $59,425 alongside the existing 50 MSFT shares.
